'''''Allium litardierei''''' is a [[North Africa]]n species of [[wild onion]] native to [[Algeria]] and [[Morocco]].<ref>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=462227 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>Litardière, René Verriet de & Maire, René Charles Joseph Ernest. 1924. Mémoires de la Société des Sciences Naturelles du Maroc  4: 21</ref>

The oldest name applied to the taxon is the 1924 moniker ''Allium paniculatum'' subsp. ''breviscapum'' <small>Litard. & Maire</small>. Elevating the epithet ''breviscapum'' to species level is prevented by the existence of the 1885 name ''Allium breviscapum'' <small>Stapf</small>, hence the need for a new name, ''Allium litardierei'' <small>J.-M.Tison</small> in 2010.<ref>Tison, J.-M. 2010. Index synonymique de la flore d'Afrique du Nord  1: 403</ref>
